meta.name: executive-onboarding-playbook
meta.description: Plan a VP or CPO 30-60-90 day diagnostic onboarding path. Use when entering a new executive product role and avoiding premature change.

copy.tagline: 规划高管入职诊断路径
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚担任产品高管，需要系统化入职计划
copy.tagline_en: Plan an executive onboarding diagnostic path
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are entering a new executive product role and need a structured onboarding plan

howto.what: Claude 会引导你按诊断、验证、行动三个阶段规划新 VP/CPO 角色的前 90 天，产出组织评估、人员地图和初始战略优先级。
howto.when: 当你开始新的 VP 或 CPO 角色、评估 CPO 职位 offer，或入职后需要验证所学时触发。

say.text: 我下个月开始担任 VP Product，帮我规划前 90 天。
say.note: 启动完整的 30-60-90 诊断流程。

say.text: 我在评估一个 CPO offer，该问 CEO 哪些问题？
say.note: 进入 Phase 0，提供面试 CEO 的五个关键问题。

say.text: 我入职两个月了，验证一下我的发现再行动。
say.note: 直接进入 Phase 2 验证阶段。

howto.what_en: Claude guides you through a three-phase diagnostic process (Diagnose, Validate, Act with Evidence) for your first 90 days as a new VP or CPO, producing an organizational assessment, people map, and initial strategic priorities.
howto.when_en: Triggered when starting a new VP or CPO role, evaluating a CPO offer, or after onboarding to validate learnings before acting.

say_en.text: I start as VP Product next month. Help me plan my first 90 days.
I'm evaluating a CPO offer. What questions should I ask the CEO?
say_en.note: Enters Phase 0 with five key probing questions.

say_en.text: I'm two months into my new role. Validate what I've learned before I act.
